title: Calibration-with-Graduation-Trigger Pattern
statement: A methodology amendment at a named workflow point specifies a calibration mechanism, a tier classification (Skill-Structure Layer or Tier-2 felt-trigger), an audit-bearing artifact that records the mechanism's operation, and a graduation trigger stating the multi-cycle evidence that promotes, relaxes, or revises the mechanism.
summary: The single decision-structure the five Cycle 019 ADRs (094 through 098) each instantiate: workflow point + calibration mechanism + tier classification + audit-bearing artifact + graduation trigger (Essay-Outline 020 C1).
caveats: Also applied by ADR-083 (Cycle 017; Outcome Test with in-place-first default) and ADR-091 (Cycle 018; dual-mode BUILD). The five-ADR clustering at one level did not recur in Cycles 017 and 018 (research log Grounding Loop 4), so the pattern's topology-level diagnostic value is single-cycle evidence.

Inherits the kitchen-sink caveat (Essay-Outline 020 C7; ADR-097): its diagnostic value depends on producing actionable distinctions at artifact-creation moments, not on being retrospectively applicable to any artifact.
The Pattern does not itself reject specific alternatives; the rejected alternatives live in each application record (spike-020 §6).
provenance: Essay-Outline 020 C1 (five ADRs compress to one Pattern record plus five entries without audit-substance loss).
